name: Browser Development Assist
description: Re-attaches the CSS file compiled by Browser Development so it keeps loading on the front-end theme after the editor module is uninstalled.
project_description: Browser Development Assist is a submodule of Browser Development. It declares a Drupal library (hook_library_info_build) pointing at the CSS file that Browser Development compiled to the public filesystem, attaches that library to the front-end when the active theme is the site default (hook_page_attachments), and raises its CSS group weight so it loads late (hook_css_alter). Its purpose is to let the main Browser Development editor module be uninstalled on production while the generated stylesheet keeps rendering, removing the editor's runtime surface for performance and hardening. It has no routes, permissions, config or dependencies of its own beyond core.
